---

## What

- Runs upstream code only: `generate_with_embeds` with and without the Fast-dLLM hook.
- Checks that the environment, weights and vision tower load on a compute node.
- Measures prompt length, per-sample time and peak memory for later runtime estimates.

---

## Why

- Every later number depends on upstream code running unchanged on our GPUs.
- Two plan assumptions needed a measurement: prompt length N (~1000 in the plan) and memory per KV copy.
- If interval 1 differs from full recompute, the hook itself changes numerics, and G1(i) needs another reference.

---

## Hypotheses

| ID | Statement | How to falsify |
|:--:|-----------|----------------|
| **H1** | Interval 1 without threshold reproduces full recompute | Any of 5 images not token-identical |
| **H2** | Prompt length stays near the plan's ~1000 tokens | Typical N ≥ 3000 (storage estimate ≥ 3× low) |
| **H3** | One KV copy fits a 40GB card | Peak memory > 40 GB |

---

## How

- Data: 5 of the 50 MME images (`src/scripts/prepare_mme.py`, seed-0 sample of 1187 unique images).
- Prompt "Please describe the image in detail."; gen_length = steps = block = 128.
- Script: [`src/scripts/smoke_phase0.py`](../../src/scripts/smoke_phase0.py), job
  [`slurm/phase0_smoke.sbatch`](../../slurm/phase0_smoke.sbatch).

| Arm | Refresh interval k | Threshold | Purpose |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|---|
| **full** | — (no cache) | none | Reference output |
| **fd_i1** | 1 | none | Hook numerics alone |
| **fd_i32** | 32 | none | Cache effect alone |
| **fd_i32_thr1** | 32 | 1 | Upstream `generate_demo.py` default |

- Time = generation only, CUDA-synchronized, without model load or preprocessing.

---

## Results

Source: [`results/phase0/smoke/smoke_summary.json`](../../results/phase0/smoke/smoke_summary.json).

| Arm | s / sample | speedup vs full | forwards (refreshes) | identical to full | word Jaccard vs full |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| **full** | 58.4 | 1.00× | 128 (128) | — | 1.000 |
| **fd_i1** | 49.3 | 1.18× | 128 (128) | 5/5 | 1.000 |
| **fd_i32** | 6.6 | 8.89× | 128 (4) | 0/5 | 0.385 |
| **fd_i32_thr1** | 5.3 | 11.07× | 100 (3.4) | 0/5 | 0.336 |

- Prompt length N = 1042 / 3715 / 3714 / 2788 / 2990 (anyres visual tokens dominate).
- Model load 27 s; peak memory 30.6 GB (full), 27.0 GB (hook arms).

### Hypothesis assessment

| Hypothesis | Verdict | Evidence |
|:----------:|:-------:|---------|
| **H1** (k=1 reproduces full) | **Confirmed** | 5/5 token-identical; the 1.18× comes from sdpa + autocast, not fewer forwards |
| **H2** (N near 1000) | **Rejected** | N = 1.0k–3.7k, typical ~3k (3× the plan) |
| **H3** (one KV copy fits 40GB) | **Confirmed** | 27–31 GB peak; two copies need the 80GB card |

---

## Insights

- **Interval 1 is a true no-cache reference** (5/5 token-identical at 1.18×).
  - G1(i) can test our loop against upstream directly; no extra reference is needed.
- **Visual tokens make N ~3× larger than planned** (typical ~3k, max 3.7k).
  - Raw KV dumps would be ~200 GB per sample; Phase 2 measures replacement error online only.
- **The upstream default mixes two effects** (8.89× from the cache alone → 11.07× with threshold 1).
  - The paper's settings had to be read off the paper before G1 (done: threshold 0.5, see Exp 3).

---

## Takeaway

Upstream runs unchanged on our cluster, and interval 1 equals full recompute token-for-token. Prompt length is
3× the plan's figure, so Phase 2 keeps replacement error online and requests 80GB cards. The run fixed
the cost profile used in every later estimate (`.claude/cluster.md`).
